sharding_contract.definition: V12:3 cases ×8 modes ×6 N =144. V13:2 X ×7 modes ×6 N =84. Each tuple is one existing history. SSPRK remains3 original process commands.

source_independence_evidence.v12: initial_driver, initial state, Instant and dx are created inside the innermost case/mode/N loop; shared constants are immutable and the CSV writer only appends records.
source_independence_evidence.v13: DriverConfig, driver/state, source clocks, initial_a, Instant and all accumulated ledgers are reset within each mode/N while body for each X command; shared scientific inputs are immutable.

sharding_contract.derivation: On the product state S=Π_i S_i, history map F_i updates only S_i with fixed immutable inputs θ_i. For i≠j, F_i∘F_j=F_j∘F_i and projection π_i of any schedule equals the serial original F_i history. Stable concatenation is a row-order operation, not a change to within-history floating arithmetic. This requires isolated mutable state and identical original body/input/solver bytes.
mechanical_generation: Keep original example files, native source and pins unchanged.
Verify exact original SHA256 and unique insertion anchors before generating newly named examples.
Mandatory case/mode/N selectors must validate before CSV creation. Missing or invalid selector must exit nonzero, not emit a header-only successful output.
V12 innermost for-loop may skip other tuples with continue.
V13 while-loop skipped N must execute n*=2 before continue; otherwise the guard loops forever. A mode guard may occur before the while loop.
Original CSV header, physical body, step loop and ledger arithmetic remain byte-identical outside inserted guards/selector validation.
Merge exactly one successful shard per catalogue key in original case/mode/N/step order; V13 merges separately per X. Reject duplicates/missing keys.
Small same-input saved-output comparison excludes timing fields and preserves raw timing as separate evidence. Do not claim new science count for the comparison.
Resume only completed receipts with matching source/generator/binary/argv/environment and raw hashes; incomplete runs are not silently accepted.
sharding_contract.scheduling_bound: For independent durations t_i and P worker tokens, ideal completion is at least max(Σt_i/P,max t_i). Finite228 ready histories permit up to64 workers but do not guarantee64-way speedup. Build CPU jobs and run jobs must share an explicit CPU/memory budget.
